comment: Backward-data (dgrad) grouped-convolution instances registered for gfx950.
One record per AOT instance, in priority order: when several instances can
run a request, the dispatcher picks the first one listed. A record spells
the instance's KernelIdentity fields that leave its family's baseline
(kernels/conv/kernel_label.py) or the defaults below; its name is the
identity's lossless label. Every instance is a shape-generic AOT binary.
